title: Digital Gujarat
text: About Us Digital Gujarat Digital Gujarat is an e-governance platform by the Government of Gujarat, providing streamlined access to essential services like certificates, scholarships, and welfare schemes. It aims to bridge the digital divide and enhance transparency and efficiency in government services. With a user-friendly design, the portal brings services directly to citizens, eliminating the need for physical visits to offices. Digital Gujarat empowers residents to access and track government resources anytime, anywhere.

title: Digital Gujarat
text: FAQ Frequently Asked Questions Digital Gujarat is an online portal launched by the Government of Gujarat to provide various digital services to its citizens. It includes services like applications for scholarships, income certificates, caste certificates, residence certificates, and other essential documents. Here’s a brief overview of common FAQs related to Digital Gujarat: Do you have any queries? Digital Gujarat is an online portal developed by the Gujarat Government to provide easy access to various government services for citizens. Through this platform, users can apply for certificates, scholarships, and essential government services, and perform Aadhar-related updates from a single portal. To register, visit the Digital Gujarat homepage and click on the 'Login/Register' button and select Citizen Login. You will be redirect to Citizen SSO Portal. More information will be available in User Manual. To apply for an Income Certificate, log in to Digital Gujarat, select 'Income Certificate' and upload documents showing proof of income, such as salary slips or bank statements. After submitting your application, you can track its status by logging in to your Digital Gujarat account and going to the 'My Applications' section.
